hook: That puddle under your car? The color tells you everything.
cta: Notice a puddle like that? Stop by and we'll take a look.

beats.visual: Overhead macro of a spreading puddle of thin amber fluid on grey driveway concrete under the front of a parked car, morning light catching the sheen, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: slow push-in on the spreading edge
beats.narration: That puddle? Color tells you a lot.

beats.visual: Three separate drips beaded on the same grey concrete slab, one dark and oily, one bright green, one pale amber, hard top light, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: slow slide across the three drips
beats.narration: Dark and oily is oil, green is coolant.

beats.visual: Extreme macro of pale amber fluid running down a rubber hose and beading at the low point, almost pink in the light, road film and grit around it, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: macro hold, single drop forming and falling
beats.narration: Thin, light amber, almost pink, is power steering fluid.

beats.visual: Under-car close shot along the steering rack between the front wheels, wet film glistening on the rack boot and the line fittings, work light from below, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.narration: It pools near the front wheels by the rack.

beats.visual: Shop bay floor, a clean drip pan set under the front of a car on a lift, a single amber drop landing in it, calm even light, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.narration: Topping it off is not the fix.
